entries.title: Psalms 31:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> In You, O LORD, I put my trust; Let me never be ashamed; Deliver me in Your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 31:2
segments: Bow down Your ear to me, Deliver me speedily; Be my rock of refuge, A fortress of defense to save me.

entries.title: Psalms 31:3
segments: For You [are] my rock and my fortress; Therefore, for Your name's sake, Lead me and guide me.

entries.title: Psalms 31:4
segments: Pull me out of the net which they have secretly laid for me, For You [are] my strength.

entries.title: Psalms 31:5
segments: Into Your hand I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

entries.title: Psalms 31:6
segments: I have hated those who regard useless idols; But I trust in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 31:7
segments: I will be glad and rejoice in Your mercy, For You have considered my trouble; You have known my soul in adversities,

entries.title: Psalms 31:8
segments: And have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; You have set my feet in a wide place.

entries.title: Psalms 31:9
segments: ¶Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I am in trouble; My eye wastes away with grief, [Yes], my soul and my body!

entries.title: Psalms 31:10
segments: For my life is spent with grief, And my years with sighing; My strength fails because of my iniquity, And my bones waste away.

entries.title: Psalms 31:11
segments: I am a reproach among all my enemies, But especially among my neighbors, And [am] repulsive to my acquaintances; Those who see me outside flee from me.

entries.title: Psalms 31:12
segments: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind; I am like a broken vessel.

entries.title: Psalms 31:13
segments: For I hear the slander of many; Fear [is] on every side; While they take counsel together against me, They scheme to take away my life.

entries.title: Psalms 31:14
segments: But as for me, I trust in You, O LORD; I say, "You [are] my God."

entries.title: Psalms 31:15
segments: My times [are] in Your hand; Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, And from those who persecute me.

entries.title: Psalms 31:16
segments: Make Your face shine upon Your servant; Save me for Your mercies' sake.

entries.title: Psalms 31:17
segments: Do not let me be ashamed, O LORD, for I have called upon You; Let the wicked be ashamed; Let them be silent in the grave.

entries.title: Psalms 31:18
segments: Let the lying lips be put to silence, Which speak insolent things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 31:19
segments: ¶Oh, how great [is] Your goodness, Which You have laid up for those who fear You, [Which] You have prepared for those who trust in You In the presence of the sons of men!

entries.title: Psalms 31:20
segments: You shall hide them in the secret place of Your presence From the plots of man; You shall keep them secretly in a pavilion From the strife of tongues.

entries.title: Psalms 31:21
segments: Blessed [be] the LORD, For He has shown me His marvelous kindness in a strong city!

entries.title: Psalms 31:22
segments: For I said in my haste, "I am cut off from before Your eyes"; Nevertheless You heard the voice of my supplications When I cried out to You.

entries.title: Psalms 31:23
segments: Oh, love the LORD, all you His saints! [For] the LORD preserves the faithful, And fully repays the proud person.

entries.title: Psalms 31:24
segments: Be of good courage, And He shall strengthen your heart, All you who hope in the LORD.
